scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved by finite-field cyclic-group identities and a complete projection-fiber count. The standalone prime-field examples are checks rather than an extrapolation proof.
scientific_limitations: The formula applies only when \(q\equiv7\pmod{12}\) and \(d=3(q+1)/4\); no analogous statement in other congruence classes or for other indices, and no independent validation, is claimed.
title: An exact cubic-residue dichotomy for fourth-quotient subfield translates
